artboards.title: Big screen — rail below, panel right
Option A — Three lines, nothing else
Option B — Lyrics plus a control rail
Option C — Lyrics plus a room panel

annotations.text:
B's control rail below, C's panel on the right.

Lyrics keep 1500x860 — the sung line at 80px with two lines of context either side, and the romanised line under it.

The panel earns its width by answering the room's two questions without anyone asking: what is next, and how do I add one.
